details.description: Yi-34B is a 34-billion-parameter bilingual (English/Chinese) base language model from 01.AI, pretrained from scratch on roughly 3 trillion multilingual tokens (data through June 2023) with a default 4,096-token context window, matching the catalog's limits. It uses a Llama-compatible transformer architecture but is trained independently rather than derived from Llama weights. 01.AI also offers an extended-context Yi-34B-200K variant and an instruction-tuned Yi-34B-Chat model; as a base (pretrained, non-chat) model, Yi-34B is intended as a foundation for fine-tuning or few-shot prompting rather than direct conversational use. 01.AI has since released the newer Yi-1.5 series, which it says further improves coding, math, reasoning and instruction-following, while describing Yi-1.5 as an addition to rather than a replacement for the original Yi models.
advantages: Scores 76.3% on MMLU and 83.7% on CMMLU, per 01.AI's Yi technical report, compared with 69.7% and 53.3% respectively for Llama 2 70B.
01.AI states Yi-34B ranked first among open-source models on the Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard and on C-Eval at the time of its release.
disadvantages: This is a base (pretrained) model, not instruction-tuned; 01.AI's own Yi-34B-Chat is intended for conversational use.
Default 4,096-token context window; 01.AI offers a separate Yi-34B-200K variant for longer contexts.
Training data extends only through June 2023, per 01.AI's model card.
use_cases: Foundation model for fine-tuning bilingual (English/Chinese) applications
Language understanding, commonsense reasoning and reading-comprehension tasks

notes: Catalog facts (4096-token max input/output, /v1/chat/completions endpoint) match the base model's default 4K context window, though this is a base/completion model rather than an instruction-tuned chat model. MMLU/CMMLU figures are from the Yi technical report's Table 2; the GitHub README describes Yi-1.5 as improving on rather than deprecating the original Yi series, so this is not described as superseded or deprecated.
